messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

Innalillahi, wa'inna ilaihirraji'un Wato a gaskiya wannan Batu Abune Mai hadarin gadke matuka Wanda tabbas idan gwamnatin tarayya batai hubbasa ba to falyakul kairan kwai🤐 Batun kuma mace mace a gaskiya Mai girma gwamna kwamitinka basa fada maka gaskiya Dan abin yayi kamarifa.

output.original_text: Innalillahi, wa'inna ilaihirraji'un Wato a gaskiya wannan Batu Abune Mai hadarin gadke matuka Wanda tabbas idan gwamnatin tarayya batai hubbasa ba to falyakul kairan kwai🤐 Batun kuma mace mace a gaskiya Mai girma gwamna kwamitinka basa fada maka gaskiya Dan abin yayi kamarifa.
output.joy: Innalillahi, wa'inna ilaihirraji'un! Wannan batu mai hadari yana da girma da fa'ida, insha'Allah gwamnati za ta dauki mataki mai kyau! Yana da aikin kirki ga gwamna, saboda duk wannan yana da makoma mai kyau.
output.sadness: Innalillahi, wa'inna ilaihirraji'un. Wannan batu yana da dumama zuciya abubuwa masu hadari na faruwa, idan gwamnatin tarayya ba ta dauki mataki ba, hakan zai jawo duka wani abu mai matsi. Gaskiya ne, gwamna, umarninka suna da wahala.
output.fear: Innalillahi, wa'inna ilaihirraji'un. Wannan batu yana da hadari sosai, idan gwamnatin tarayya ba ta dauki mataki ba, hakan na iya zama mai mummunar sakamako! Gaskiya, gwamna, akwai abubuwa masu ban tsoro da suke faruwa a yanzu.
output.anger: Innalillahi, wa'inna ilaihirraji'un! Wannan batu na da hadari wanda kawai ke faruwa saboda gwamnati ba ta kula da shi ba! Gaskiya ne, gwamna, kamata ya yi ka ji gaskiyar abin, domin hakan ba ya dace!
output.surprise: Innalillahi, wa'inna ilaihirraji'un! Wannan batu yana da girma da ban mamaki, idan gwamnatin tarayya ba ta dauki mataki ba, zamu ga wani abu mai ban sha'awa! Gaskiya ne, gwamna, abubuwa masu faruwa suna da tayar da hankali.
output.disgust: Innalillahi, wa'inna ilaihirraji'un! Wannan batu yana da hadari sosai, abin mamaki ma, idan gwamnatin tarayya ba ta dauki mataki ba, hakan yakan sa mu yi zaton wani mummunar abu. Gaskiya ne, gwamna, ba za ka yarda da wannan ba!
